episode_appearances.pitch: Premium honey wine made from raw honey and spring water
episode_appearances.offer: $750,000 for 40% from Mark Cuban, Lori Greiner, Robert Herjavec and Daniel Lubetzky

timeline.event: A federal trademark record identifies The Honey Wine Company LLC in connection with the BEE D'VINE mark; the company's exact formation date is not inferred from the trademark date.
Ayele Solomon presented Bee d'Vine on Shark Tank and accepted the four-Shark on-air offer.
Later Shark Tank follow-up coverage reported that the four-Shark deal never closed while the company remained in business.
The official site continues to offer honey wines for online purchase and provides dispatch and customer-support channels; California ABC records list The Honey Wine Company LLC.

claims.text: Bee d'Vine is operating as a current honey-wine brand with an online store and customer-support channels.
The Honey Wine Company, LLC is the legal identity named in the federal BEE D'VINE trademark record and in California alcohol-licensing material.
Ayele Solomon accepted a $750,000-for-40% four-Shark offer on air, but later reporting says the deal never closed.
The public record supports continued operation but does not reveal why the televised investment failed to close.

episode_appearances.video_title: Shark Tank US | 'I'm Going To Applaud Watching Cuban And Sacca Fight To Get BitsBox'
episode_appearances.pitch: A subscription coding-project service for children
episode_appearances.offer: $250,000 for 20% from Chris Sacca, later withdrawn after a counteroffer

timeline.event: The founders' official company history says Scott Lininger quit his job in 2014 and launched the company with Aidan Chopra; the exact founding date is not specified.
The official company blog announced Bitsbox's national Shark Tank debut.

Aidan Chopra's post-show account says Sacca withdrew his offer after a counteroffer, Bitsbox left without a deal, and the company raised from non-celebrity investors while experiencing a major publicity-driven growth surge.
The current Bitsbox site remains live with coding products, subscriptions and support; its official terms identify Codepops, Inc. as the company behind the service.

events: A government trademark journal identifies Codepops, Inc. DBA Bitsbox at a Boulder, Colorado address
registry_records.limitation: The Colorado Secretary of State entity record and current standing were not directly retrieved in this pass; the official terms and government trademark journal establish the legal-name trail but not current registry standing.

claims.text: Bitsbox is operating as a current coding-education service with a live site, subscriptions and support channels.
Codepops, Inc. is the contracting company identified in Bitsbox's official terms, and government trademark material identifies Codepops, Inc. DBA Bitsbox.
Bitsbox did not close a Shark Tank investment: the founders' dated post-show account says the sole remaining offer was withdrawn after a counteroffer.
The founders reported raising money from non-celebrity investors and gaining a substantial post-airing publicity boost; those growth claims are company-reported rather than independently audited.
